$comment: Small-model bench matrix (ATO-1118). The ONE place for models, windows, repeats and llama-server flags. Nothing here runs by itself: run.mjs reads it, --dry-run prints the plan.

server.$comment: Same flags for every model: plain f16 KV cache, no TurboQuant, one slot, so rows compare models and not server tweaks. {gguf} {alias} {port} {window} are filled per cell. --jinja is required for tool calls.

agent.$comment: Only what a headless run needs; everything else stays at the product default because the bench measures what users get. Per-task maxSteps comes from the task. thinking is set per cell (localModels.thinking).
